import time, numpy as np
start=time.time()
n=205; m=500000
G=np.empty((n,m), dtype=np.int8)
with open('q1_raw.raw') as f:
    header=f.readline().split()
    print('header',len(header), header[6:8])
    for i,line in enumerate(f):
        p=line.split()
        vals=p[6:6+m]
        G[i]=np.fromiter(map(int, vals), dtype=np.int8, count=m)
print('read sec', time.time()-start, G.shape, G.dtype, G.nbytes/1e6)
# compute per individual het count: sum G==1
het=G==1
het_count=het.sum(axis=1)
print('het range',het_count.min(),het_count.max(),'sum',het_count.sum())
# Compute pair counts chunked
chunk=20000
both_het=np.zeros((n,n),dtype=np.float32)
opp=np.zeros((n,n),dtype=np.float32)
for s in range(0,m,chunk):
    B=G[:,s:s+chunk].astype(np.float32)
    both_het += (B==1).astype(np.float32) @ (B==1).astype(np.float32).T
    # opp: one 0 one 2
    d0=(B==0).astype(np.float32); d2=(B==2).astype(np.float32)
    opp += d0 @ d2.T + d2 @ d0.T
    if s%100000==0: print('chunk',s)
print('matrix sec', time.time()-start)
den = het_count[:,None]+het_count[None,:]
kinship = np.divide(both_het - 2*opp, den, out=np.zeros_like(both_het), where=den"'!=0)
np.fill_diagonal(kinship,0)
# top pairs
iu=np.triu_indices(n,k=1)
vals=kinship[iu]
print('"'kinship max', vals.max(), 'min', vals.min())
top=np.argsort(vals)[::-1][:30]
for idx in top:
    i,j=iu[0][idx],iu[1][idx]
    print(i,j,vals[idx], 'counts', both_het[i,j], opp[i,j], den[i,j])
# how many > .2 .25
for t in [0.35,0.3,0.25,0.2,0.15,0.1]:
    print('>',t,(vals>t).sum())
